authority: Concrete proposal for owner and independent trust/security review; P2-SEVERITY/P2-EVAL approval does not admit this policy.

subject.names: Exactly one canonical npm purl for the trusted package/version, with %40 for scoped @; no basename/alias/digest-only match.
subject.digests: Require sha512 or sha256 of the exact observed archive bytes; verify every declared supported digest. Unknown algorithm or conflicting/duplicate subject is unresolved. Authenticated wrong subject is invalid.
subject.localInputs: Never inherit registry identity or provenance success; modified bytes require a new observation and exact subject verification.

trustedExpectations.origin: Explicit host-owned policy values reviewed independently of target metadata; registry/manifest/envelope values are evidence, never their own expected identity.
trustedExpectations.sanMatching: Exact anchored escaped literal; library strings are regex patterns, never pass an unescaped identity.
trustedExpectations.externalParameters: Only workflow.repository, workflow.path and workflow.ref allowed in this profile; compare exact expected values. Unknown fields are indeterminate.
trustedExpectations.source: Require unique resolvedDependency repository URI plus full gitCommit; compare all source assertions and certificate OIDs. Subtree/build-context assertion missing when required remains indeterminate; no inference from working directory or matching files.

certificateOIDs.1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.13: source repository digest = expected full commit
certificateOIDs.1.3.6.1.4.1.57264.1.14: source repository ref = expected workflow/source ref

trustedExpectations.oidCompatibility: This draft requires provider-generic OIDs; legacy missing/deprecated extensions remain unsupported. DER decoding/representation must receive exact-fixture admission before use.

roots.bootstrap: Owner-reviewed authenticated Sigstore TUF initial root, exact SHA-256 and version, then independently verified signed metadata chain/expiry/rollback checks. No bootstrap anchor is admitted here.
roots.snapshots: Immutable root/TUF metadata/policy/verifier closure stored by full digest and version in each observation.
roots.update: Explicit bounded host operation creates a new snapshot and observation; require reviewed HTTPS hosts, no redirects outside exact allowlist, signed rotation/threshold/expiry and monotonic version checks. No implicit library fetch/cache/root refresh.
roots.offline: Use only the selected approved snapshot. Proposed maximum 30 days since authenticated snapshot capture for a new policy decision; stale/unavailable/expired material yields indeterminate, never pass.
roots.rollback: Deny older versions except an explicit independently reviewed incident rollback recorded as a new policy version.

cryptoRequirements.signingTime: Signed log entry timestamp or admitted RFC3161 timestamp; not unauthenticated integratedTime. Require chain/log/CA valid-for intervals at authenticated signing time. Current leaf expiry alone does not erase historical validity.
cryptoRequirements.log: Verify inclusion proof and signed checkpoint; reject duplicate log/timestamp entries, unknown versions, unsupported checkpoint structure and unsigned trailing lines.
cryptoRequirements.multipleAttestations: Retain all. Every applicable build assertion for exact subject must be verified and agree on required fields; conflicting verified assertions yield indeterminate. Wrong-subject assertions remain visible and cannot satisfy the target. Publish assertions never satisfy build policy.
cryptoRequirements.certificate: Reject malformed/untrusted chains and unmet signer/issuer/OID expectations. No email/OAuth or self-hosted runner profile admitted by this draft.

required-v1.validCryptoAllExpectations: verified_policy / matched; policy pass; exit 0 if otherwise complete
required-v1.unknownUnsupportedMissingStaleConflictin: unresolved or not_checked as observed; policy indeterminate; exit 2

outcomes.optional-v1: Same invalid/mismatch/unresolved handling. Completed bounded discovery with no build assertion may pass policy while provenance remains absent; do not claim global cryptographic absence.
outcomes.noPolicy: Crypto may be recorded separately only after verifier admission. Policy stays not_evaluated; requested incomplete verification yields exit 2.
outcomes.precedence: No report 3; policy violation 1; otherwise incomplete/failed analysis or indeterminate policy 2; otherwise 0. Severity never chooses exit 1.

containment.cancellation: Parent must terminate an isolated verification worker and confirm settlement; never present an in-process timeout as preemption. This execution design still requires review.
containment.network: Offline verification only; no signing, OIDC, provider, registry writes, build or target execution.

compatibility: Retain G0 0.1.0 only if evidence records honestly encode these observations; otherwise obtain P2-COMPAT before any incompatible implementation. Preserve six outcomes, original claims/conflicts, raw residuals and independent AI state.
